I joined on feb 21" and after completion of you tube likes, received aforesaid amount for which proofs have been attached.
Following this, I continued to complete tasks, but on feb 22, I was given task 18 under the supervision of a teacher named Amar Anand from Zebra Techies.
He assign me under a group of four (work members).
The mobile number of teacher 918855917902 and username of Telegram @ Amar_ Anand01 is attached as proof with this letter.
The teacher guided us four to perform certain merchant tasks.
It was on February 23rd, that I was asked to create a username and password on Bitfinex (www.bitfinex.com) and were strictly asked to not change any thing.
The bitfinex is a multi trading exchange company.
Which I knew nothing about.
I was working username kingra and password 123456 and was asked to perform stepwise instructions an finish tasks.

He said our money will not be given until we help them recover the loss that I made because of wrong section.
I got panicked as other people in group suffered along with me too.

As a humanitarian, act I choose to pay the asked amount of about 1,90,000/-
as others three members whose ids and mobile numbers were unknown as well on telegram.
They claimed to be working for 5 months, 4 months and one of them was knew as me they were always tready to accept highest prepaid orders to get maximum profits as was shared against the tsasks.
Building up that amount of trust, I deposited money in all the given accounts and UPI ids as enclosed.
I was not still paid but others were and the reason cited was that my credit score was 80% on Bitfines which halted my withdrawal.
They asked me to sum up the score to 100% by depositing certain amounts.
After which I would be able to withdraw my money from my bitfinex work account.

Earlier than this, I was asked to pay tax amount as well of 30%
of the amount of earned.
Which is subjected to indian Crypto exchanges.
This seemed to be genuine to me and I did that.
To my sadness, even these things could not help me get my money.
I was kept on told different reasons to help me recover the money.
The receptionist and some merchant (as they say) helped me increase my credit score as I was unable to pay their huge money demands.
They said merchant can give me 20-40% refund and such nuisance things to get my support.

I was hereby assured of just pay 2,50,000 in the end to get the lumpsome amount.

Unfortunately, this did not stop and now,
they ask me to build a large work channel in their language which means deposit about 6 lakh more to get final amount of 51 lakhs after profit, which sounds bizarre to me.
after incurring several losses, I informed my husband in fear and embarrassment about the fraud.
I have made a note of all the user ids for your perusal and investigation.
I would to request you to promptly investigate into these aforesaid offences by unknown users and take strict action against them in law.
Thank you in advance for your efforts.
Regards Nimarta Kingra (House No.3091, Sec 22-D, Chd.)

The said Vishal Verma is stated to have suffered disclosure wherein he has named the present petitioner.
Apart from that it is further claimed that the sim number attached to the bank account is being used by the mobile set in the name of the petitioner.
The petitioner is stated to be behind bars since 30th of July, 2023.
5. I have heard counsel for the parties and have gone through records of the case.

6. Without commenting on the merits of the case, in view of the allegations levelled against the petitioner, the nature of the offence and keeping in view the incarceration already suffered by the petitioner, the present petition is allowed.
The petitioner is ordered to be released on bail on his furnishing bail bonds/surety bonds to the satisfaction of the Trial Court/Duty Magistrate concerned.

7. Needless to say that anything observed hereinabove shall not be construed to be an expression of opinion on the merits of the case.
